changes.change: Only the DNA manifest is read: the item whose document element is manifest in urn:dnacalc:view-manifest, found by reading each item's first event. An item the XML reader refuses before its document element (UTF-16, an encoding declaration other than UTF-8, a malformed start tag) counts as a DNA manifest that cannot be read when its bytes hold the namespace URI as UTF-8, UTF-16 or UTF-32 of either byte order, as does an item whose document element is another element of that namespace and an item whose content cannot be read at all; each gives LayoutWarning::UnreadableManifest naming its part, and a save that changes the layout is refused (SaveRefusal::LayoutNotWritable). Other items, their item properties and every orphan or related part are neither read nor reported; they are copied as stored.
changes.reason: The bead persists one DNA manifest; general custom XML editing is cdoc-m6.4's. A DNA manifest the XML reader refuses is counted rather than skipped, so its views never disappear without a warning and a layout save never writes a second manifest beside it (round-1 judge, item 1).

changes.change: The item is identified by its document element, not by the datastore itemID of its item properties, which CalcDoc does not read.
changes.reason: The manifest's identity is its content; reading item properties would add a refusal path (OxDoc's CustomXmlStoreNotEditable) that the manifest does not need.

changes.change: More than one DNA manifest is a recovery warning (LayoutWarning::UnreadableManifest) and the layout is not loaded, not a refusal of the load.
changes.reason: The claim note: nothing is deleted and no layout is invented; the workbook still loads.

semantic_changes.change: A locator is only a hidden (hidden="1" or "true"), workbook-scoped defined name named _dna.block. and 32 hex digits. A manifest block whose locator attribute names any other name (a user's Rate, a visible or sheet-scoped name of that form) loads without an anchor (LayoutWarning::UnresolvedLocator), and a layout save never removes or changes that name; a layout save removes only hidden, workbook-scoped names of that form that are the locator of a block it removed.

semantic_changes.change: A rewritten manifest keeps every byte between the children of blocks, views and each view (whitespace, comments, processing instructions) and every unknown child in its place among the known ones: the blocks or placements of the new order take the source's places in turn, so an unknown child after the second placement stays after the second placement of the new order. Comments and unknown content inside a removed block or placement go with it; nothing else is dropped.
semantic_changes.reason: Preserve unknown manifest fields on compatible edits (the bead's Do); the round-1 rewrite dropped comments and moved unknown children after the known ones (round-1 judge, item 8).

limits: Unmeasured choices that the owner's Excel check settles (an agent cannot run Excel): every DNA manifest's item properties carry the one fixed datastore itemID {8C3B6A52-1D4E-4F7A-9B20-5E61D7C4A913}; the manifest namespace and schemaRef is urn:dnacalc:view-manifest; a locator's text always quotes the sheet name ('Notebook'!$B$5). Whether Excel opens a saved package without a repair prompt and keeps the manifest and the hidden names through its own save is not shown by any case.

The grid view of the DNA manifest holds only the order of its placements. The Excel grid's own view state (selection, scroll, frozen panes, zoom) stays in each worksheet's sheetViews, which calc-doc copies as written; nothing in the DNA manifest duplicates it. Recorded as the orchestrator decided (round-1 judge, item 9).

A block may be created over cells of a hidden or veryHidden sheet: ModelRoot::apply checks only that the anchor's sheet exists, since plan section 8.2 also allows linking existing cells (round-1 judge, item 12).

An item the XML reader refuses is recognized as a DNA manifest only by the namespace URI in its bytes (UTF-8 or an ASCII-compatible encoding, UTF-16, UTF-32); a manifest whose namespace URI is written only with character references, or in another encoding, is not recognized and the package loads as one without a manifest.

LoadedWorkbook::check_layout_save judges each layout edit, not the revision: edits that leave the layout as loaded (a block created and removed again) are judged as edits, though a save of that revision writes no layout. prepare_save stays the last check, and also refuses for reasons the check does not judge, such as a workbook part with two definedNames elements.
